deliverables: Instant on-chain distribution of funds to the intended recipient upon enactment
request.recipient: the Ikigai Info governance action submitter
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to reimburse the lost deposit for the Ikigai Info governance action, plus compensation for staking rewards.

claims.claim: An Info governance action titled "Cardanoの生きがい - Ikigai -" was submitted in September 2024 shortly after the Chang hard fork.
The Ikigai Info governance action was symbolic and asked whether the community agreed with a statement of thanks and hope for Cardano's future.
A Cardano node bug allowed an unregistered stake key to be used for the governance action, preventing the submitter from recovering the 100,000 ADA deposit.
The proposal requests 103,000 ADA, consisting of the original 100,000 ADA deposit plus 3,000 ADA for lost staking rewards calculated at 2% per year.
The proposal states there were significant community sentiments at the time that the Ikigai Info governance action deposit should be reimbursed.
The Cardano in Oceania initiative included this reimbursement in a budget Info governance action, but that governance action was not approved.
The recipient has not previously received funds from the treasury.
The requested amount does not exceed the current Net Change Limit.
The Cardano community will be able to audit the distribution on-chain because funds will be made directly available to the intended recipient.
The proposal provides an external reference to an AdaStat governance action page.

summary: The proposal asks for 103,000 ADA to reimburse a claimed unrecoverable 100,000 ADA governance action deposit and 3,000 ADA in lost staking rewards, with most key causal, eligibility, and NCL claims asserted rather than evidenced inside the document.
